observing.naked_eye: Visible unaided as a small stellar haze or loose knot under a dark sky.
observing.binoculars: An excellent binocular target: the cluster separates from the field and its brightest members begin to stand out. The field lies within the Almanack's visible Milky Way boundary, so the background is especially star-rich.
observing.telescope: Low to moderate power resolves many more members; use a wide field first so the cluster remains visually coherent.
